Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
First they were Li’l, then they were Li’l’er, now they’re just the Li’l’est Planeswalkers we ever did see! Five new powerfully precious cards from artist UTA NATSUME just scampered through the multiverse and are ready for combat, or a cuddle, it’s kinda up to you.

• 1x Rainbow Foil Karn, Scion of Urza
• 1x Rainbow Foil Chandra, Flame’s Catalyst
• 1x Rainbow Foil Aminatou, the Fateshifter
• 1x Rainbow Foil Daretti, Ingenious Iconoclast
• 1x Rainbow Foil Venser, the Sojourner
Li’l’est Walkers Foil Edition will be printed using our experimental new Rainbow Foil treatment. Rainbow Foil is a lot like traditional foil, but it's printed using a different technique and has more vibrant colors.
